sentences.original_text: Welcome to English in a Minute!
sentences.translated_text: 歡迎收看「一分鐘學英語」！

sentences.original_text: Some people use a large ball for exercise.
sentences.translated_text: 有些人會用大球來運動。

sentences.original_text: Is that what to get “on the ball” means?
sentences.translated_text: 「get on the ball」是這個意思嗎？

sentences.original_text: Hi Anna! How has your day been?
I finished three reports and have only one more to do!
sentences.translated_text: 我完成了三份報告，只剩一份要做！

sentences.original_text: Wow, you are on the ball!
How did you do them so fast?
Coffee! Lots of coffee. Do you want some?
sentences.translated_text: 咖啡！很多很多咖啡。你要來一點嗎？

sentences.original_text: I’ll get it. I’d love more coffee. Thank you!
sentences.translated_text: 我去拿。我很想再喝點咖啡。謝謝你！

sentences.original_text: Uh, sure. But maybe not that much coffee.
sentences.translated_text: 呃，好啊。不過也許不用那麼多咖啡。

sentences.original_text: Someone who is “on the ball” finishes work quickly and ahead of time.
sentences.translated_text: 「on the ball」的人做事又快，還能提前完成。

sentences.original_text: We can also say a person should “get on the ball” when they need to work faster or better.
sentences.translated_text: 當某人需要做得更快或更好時，我們也可以說他應該「get on the ball（打起精神）」。

sentences.original_text: And that’s English in a Minute!
sentences.translated_text: 以上就是「一分鐘學英語」！
